content: Golden-file testing for data pipelines: canonical CI recipe is regenerate-then-diff — CI regenerates derived artifacts and runs 'git diff --exit-code' (or git diff --no-index --exit-code / git status --porcelain) on committed goldens; dirty tree fails the build with the diff shown. Updates go through an explicit gated path (update flag, PR title tag, or push to main). Gotchas: merges of golden files can produce incorrect results (MongoDB SERVER-100324) so regenerate after merges; elide generated content from PR review diffs; detect stale goldens (files no longer produced). Dart pub repo pattern: wholesale regenerate, review with git diff before committing.
